name: Tiger 5
subtitle: Wing double screen away
goal: Sell 4 as the first option, then spring 3 through a double screen for a layup.
options: Best: 3 catching at the free throw line and finishing at speed. 4 in the short corner is the decoy.

steps.note: 4 goes to screen for 2. At the same time, 1 and 5 set a double screen for 3.
4 slips to the short corner, calling for the ball. 4 is the decoy. 3 explodes through the two screens, and 2 hits 3 at the free throw line.
3 keeps going straight down the lane at full speed for the layup.
